Comparing all six potentially nonzero coefficients of the transformed homogeneous equation forces a norm-one alpha, w=1, u=-alpha beta^s and Trace(v)=-Norm(beta); the converse holds. Norm/trace counts yield s^3(s+1), and matrix multiplication proves the nonabelian Heisenberg semidirect structure and quaternion s=2 case. Exact executable exhaustive checks in F4/F9 found 24 and 108 stabilizers. The symbolic argument, not finite cases, proves all prime powers.
